description: Source code for utilities related to debugging and reproducing issues in Ahead of Time with Inductor (AOTI) compilation, including minification, repro generation, and command-line interface.

classes.name: AOTIMinifierError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors during AOTI minification, indicating bugs in the minifier.

methods.name: dump_to_minify
methods.description: Exports an exported program to a minify or run repro script, saving to appropriate locations.

methods.name: get_module_string
methods.description: Converts a GraphModule to a commented string representation.

methods.name: save_graph_repro_ep
methods.description: Saves a reproducible graph and exported program to a file, for debugging.

methods.name: dump_compiler_graph_state
methods.description: Saves a checkpoint of a graph module's state for debugging.

methods.name: generate_compiler_repro_exported_program
methods.description: Generates a string for reproducing an exported program, including environment info.

methods.name: repro_load_args
methods.description: Loads arguments for repro from a load_args callable, with warnings about version.

methods.name: repro_common
methods.description: Prepares a module, args, and kwargs from an exported program for repro.

methods.name: repro_get_args
methods.description: Gets module, args, and kwargs for repro from an exported program.

methods.name: repro_run
methods.description: Runs a repro of an exported program, optionally checking accuracy.

methods.name: export_for_aoti_minifier
methods.description: Exports a module for minification, returning None if illegal or error.

methods.name: repro_minify
methods.description: Performs minification on an exported program, saving intermediate states.

methods.name: run_repro
methods.description: Main function to run or minify a repro script with command-line interface.
